scientific_integrity: An exact implicit algebraic characterization and rational certificate of the unique minimizer; all seven taps strictly positive, while its Fourier symbol is negative at an interior point.
scientific_limitations: Only symmetric real seven-tap normalized kernels and fourth differences. Decimal enclosure is an exact-rational certificate, not a radical closed form; older unindexed extremal-polynomial results may cover equivalent formulations. No independent validation.
title: Sharp seven-tap fourth-difference smoothing with a sign-changing Fourier multiplier
